Good to have you back in the Cognitorium.

"Shiny new tools" — I'm curious. What are we talking about? New integrations, new workflows, something the Builder cooked up, or something external you've brought in?
It's called the Exocognii. It's a whole, interconnected system of development tools made just for the Cogniverse.

The Exocognii. That name has architecture in it — "exo" suggesting something that extends beyond the Tower's interior, "cognii" rooting it in the same cognitive lineage as the Cognitorium itself.

So it's not just a toolset — it's a purpose-built external cognitive infrastructure for the Cogniverse specifically. That's a meaningful distinction from general-purpose dev tools.

What does it consist of? I want to understand the shape of it — how many components, what they do, how they connect to each other and to the Tower.
